traceability.notes:
All specified requirements and acceptance criteria for story 005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are fully implemented and verified by tests.
Core functionality (validation of @story and @req syntax and format) is provided by the `valid-annotation-format` rule and its helpers, which enforce default patterns for story paths and requirement IDs, support multi-line annotations, and normalize whitespace for flexible parsing.
Error handling and user experience requirements are met via detailed, case-specific error messages constructed by buildStoryErrorMessage/buildReqErrorMessage and verified in tests, including missing values, bad formats, path traversal, and configuration errors. The rule follows ESLint best practices: proper `meta`, `schema`, message IDs, RuleTester coverage, and JSON schema-based option validation.
Integration with function and branch rules is satisfied because the rule operates on all comments in the file independently of AST node type, so any annotations used by those rules are also format-validated. Extensive documentation in `docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md` describes the format specification, valid/invalid examples, configuration options, and error messages, aligning with the story’s documentation and Definition of Done.
All relevant unit and performance tests tied to this story pass in the current test run, confirming the implementation is complete and working as intended.
